MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000139
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00878818
WELLS FARGO BANK, N.A., is the
Plaintiff, and MACAULAY WILLIAMS,
ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of
execution for the sale of mortgaged
premises dated 12/2/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 25TH DAY of
MARCH A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o' clock by the then
prevailing (Standard or Daylight
Saving) time, in the afternoon of
the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in BOROUGH OF SOUTH RIVER in
the COUNTY OF MIDDLESEX, and
STATE OF NEW JERSEY commonly
known at 66 BURTON AVENUE,
SOUTH RIVER, NJ 08882.
Lot: 5.02, Block: 63 f/k/a Lot 5.2
Block 63.
Dimensions of Lots : (Approximately) 138 x 75 x 138 x 75.
Nearest Cross Street: HOLLANDER
STREET.
The sale is subject to any unpaid
taxes and assessments, tax, water
and sewer liens and other municipal
assessments. The amount due can
be obtained from the local taxing
authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to
the limited lien priority of any
condominium/home-owner association liens which may exist. The
sale may be further subject to
Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record.
The occupancy status of the
subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is
$1,082.805.86 calculated through
January 2, 2026 in plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's
cost and commission to the date of
sale.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of SEVEN HUNDRED
EIGHTY TWO THOUSAND THREE
HUNDRED FORTY EIGHT DOLLARS
AND FORTY ONE CENTS
($782,348.41) dollars more or less,
plus interest together with the
costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Logs Legal Group LLP
14000 Commerce Parkway Suite B
Mount Laurel, NJ 08054
Attorneys
